text:
Jamie: Anyone else seeing the us-west GPU pool flattened by a single tenant this morning? Queue length shot from 20 -> 900 in 15m.
Leila: Yep. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/pools/us-west/gpu-1 — tenant "tenant-bolt" accounts for ~68% of in-flight requests. Pending latency >10s for others.
Chris: Saw that. Their batch jobs started at 09:12 and never backpressured. We're on a shared pool without per-tenant concurrency limits.
Anya: Can we do soft admission control + fairshare queueing? Prefer queue over hard rejects for prod customers.
Jamie: Agree. Proposal: per-tenant token-bucket + weighted fair queue. If pool baseline saturation > 80% for 60s, switch from unlimited to admission.
Chris: Sketch of config I tested locally:
```
admission_control:
  mode: auto
  trigger:
    cpu_util_pct: 80
    duration_s: 60
  algorithm: token_bucket
  token_bucket:
    default_capacity: 50
    refill_per_s: 5
  fairshare_weights:
    tenant-bolt: 1
    tenant-core: 3
    tenant-caesar: 2
```
Leila: Two operational notes: 1) need to persist tokens per-tenant across leaders (we can use redis). 2) backpressure must expose Retry-After header and a queue position metric.
Anya: For immediate mitigation we can set a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap of 100 on that pool and a rule to route overflow to dedicated capacity for enabled tenants.
Jamie: What's the rollback story if we break something? I want canary rollout to 10% of requests and metrics: 95p latency, error rate, tokens consumed, queue_depth.
capacity-bot: [ALERT] pool us-west/gpu-1 exceeded pressure threshold at 2026-03-18T09:12:10Z — queued: 912, in_flight: 312
Chris: Load test command I used:
```
./tools/loadgen --target pool://us-west/gpu-1 --concurrency 500 --tenant tenant-bolt --qps 1200
```
Leila: Cost note: if we route to dedicated, committed spend rises. But noisy tenant throttling recovers 70-80% of baseline perf => cheaper than adding GPUs.
Jamie: Ok. Action items:
- Chris: open RFC with config + redis-based token store + metrics (by EOD)
- Anya: prototype fairshare queue in staging and add Retry-After header (tomorrow)
- Leila: add dashboard panels (queue pos, tokens, per-tenant in_flight)
I'll schedule a quick sync 10:30.
Anya: ack :+1:
Chris: sending RFC now.
Leila: I'll patch alert to include tenant label.
Jamie: Thanks all — let's avoid a repeat during peak later today.
